records.issue_text: ClientPermissionsV2.java:77–79: canView(client) immediately grants access for global VIEW permission without evaluating client-specific permissions, preventing a negative VIEW permission for an individual client from restricting the global grant.
records.rationale: Looking at ClientPermissionsV2.canView(ClientModel client) at lines 77-79, the method returns true immediately if canView() returns true (which checks global VIEW permission). This means if a user has global VIEW permission on all clients, they cannot be denied VIEW access to a specific client via a negative permission.
